name: Graveyard Hider
description: Hides every channel in the dead-channel group (IPTV Checker's Graveyard) from all outputs (M3U, EPG, Xtream) and unhides it once it has left the group. Runs every hour at :20 through Dispatcharr's scheduler. Only unhides channels it hid itself.
author: local

fields.label: Dead-channel group
fields.help_text: Channels in this group are hidden from all outputs.

actions.label: Preview
actions.description: Show which channels would be hidden or unhidden. Changes nothing.

actions.label: Apply
actions.description: Hide and unhide now, and arm the hourly schedule.

actions.label: Unhide all
actions.description: Unhide every channel this plugin has hidden and stop the schedule.

confirm.message: Unhide every channel Graveyard Hider has hidden and stop its schedule?
